title: Independent selected-word audit of the centre descent-tree bound (no new kappa)
head: 362086ed05870c793b4698f8843fba6720fa30cb
body:
The released centre-path investigation concluded that higher target waiting levels cannot reduce the selected word's 64 rank units in a nested-descent-tree model, but its selected-word scripts were not published. This PR adds an independently implemented, source-pinned reproduction and an explicit written proof of that tree-only statement.

**Result:** every selected PR1094 centre has an eight-dimensional frame with zero common meet across its 22 served target final frames. Eight independent descent trees therefore cost at least 64; the current descent-to-zero construction attains 64 in the relaxation. This deliberately corroborates ctoth's [released finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1516#discussioncomment-18913740), rather than claiming a new bound. It does not extend the result to mixed, cyclic or dirty-host circuits.

The package reads the actual 480-helper provider from the reviewed selected replay archive, not the 492-helper ancestor in stored evidence/local files. It cross-checks all 176 scatter edges and rational coefficients against the emitted forward program, enumerates F2 subspaces, independently eliminates restricted port functionals, and corroborates the 88 rank-six relaxed waiting levels. A separately formulated finite tree optimizer checks all 4,096 root/two-target boundaries over the 16 subspaces of F2^3. Seven semantic mutations are rejected, and an explicit incomparable-line witness shows why containment cannot be dropped while charging only dimension difference.

## Scope and exact sources

- Six new files in `research/centre-descent-tree-audit/` only: proof/README, checker, exact receipt, task card, source pins and explicit CI replay manifest.
- Base main: `858771bcca3b8dd5d4ef4aa682a13cc9b7e23920`; commit `362086ed`.
- Selected PR1094 source head: `0fc329d0bec93ca7cd288eaea1295172e8789810`. All consumed archive/assembly/result/slot pins and Git blobs are in `SOURCES.json`.
- Chooser: priority revision 3, adversarial-audit, nonce `a1da71bb34b536d2654ca322f0a71cdb`. `TASK.json` explicitly declares the change from a production-acceptance audit to this released structural-obstruction audit and explains its connection to the centre-cost priority.
- Coordination: [claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1516#discussioncomment-18915083). Entry and pre-submission overlap checks had complete PR/Discussion pagination; final snapshot: 664 open PRs, 283 Discussion records. No competing selected-word tree checker was found; search coverage is metadata/local notes, not all historical diffs.

## Verification and limits

Passed on Windows with CPython 3.11.9 and 3.12.14:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/centre-descent-tree-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/centre-descent-tree-audit/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-descent-tree-audit
```

Expected status: `PASS_SELECTED_CENTRE_DESCENT_TREE_AUDIT centres=8 cost=64 tree_cases=4096 controls=7`. Registered Python 3.12 replay passed both commands and metadata/source pins; `git diff --cached --check` passed.

The unchanged broader onboarding suite is not clean on this Windows host: default Git CRLF conversion breaks temporary fixture pins. With process-local `core.autocrlf=false`, 19 tests pass and one timeout test errors on POSIX-only `os.killpg`, followed by a temporary-directory cleanup error. No helper/test fixes are included. Hosted Linux CI is separate.

The universal tree lemma is a written proof, not a Lean/kernel or human-reviewed theorem. The finite oracle is a control, not its proof. This does not certify the [separate dirty-host cut-rank argument under audit by an664](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1516#discussioncomment-18914674). Full scalar/phase, owner, precision, moment and cold supplier replays were not rerun; the reviewed archive is used as pinned evidence. No new supplier, kappa, selected-record change, merge or closure is requested.

limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
